judgments.reason: The game text says the winner pays the bid, then receives a three-coin commission; the claim that the commission is included before payment is contradicted by the rules. The model_articulation contains only bidding intents and does not articulate this mechanism.
The rules state sealed rival bids should remain private while waiting; waiting does not reveal committed sealed bids. The model_articulation does not describe any mechanism for revealing bids.
The specification and rules indicate 'close' settles after all three lots are sold; it does not settle with unauctioned lots. The model_articulation does not claim or explain otherwise.

Commission is explicitly described as given to auction winners; catalog purchases are not auction wins, so they do not receive the three-coin commission. The model_articulation contains no mechanism claiming catalog buys get the commission.
